artworks.title: Christ Taking Leave from His Mother
artworks.description: The image shows four people gathered outdoors. On the right, a standing individual with long wavy hair and a beard is gesturing. In the center, a seated person is looking upwards, wearing a detailed gown and a bonnet-like head covering. Next to them stands another person in a long dress and headgear, also looking in the same direction. Behind them, a third figure wears a long robe and a distinctive headpiece. The group is under a wooden structure with a large tree to the right. In the background is a cityscape with castle-like buildings and mountains, and a partially cloudy sky.

artworks.title: The Holy Family with Two Music-Making Angels
artworks.description: The image is a woodcut artwork depicting eight people gathered closely together outdoors amongst trees. In the center, a seated woman holds a swaddled infant, while another woman next to her tends to the child. Surrounding them are bearded men in robes and head coverings of the era. Some individuals are standing, while others lean in towards the central figures, gesturing with their hands. Two small children play at their feet. The scene is set against a backdrop of trees with intricate bark, foliage, and a rolling hill in the distance. The number "1511" is inscribed at the top. The composition is detailed with cross-hatching and line work for texture and depth.

artworks.title: The Virgin Surrounded by Many Angels
artworks.description: Drawing of a religious scene showing angelic figures and a central maternal figure with a child. Detailed line work and shading emphasize various figures, including angels with wings surrounding a central luminescent figure holding a child. Cherubic attendants are engaged in various activities, alongside elements like elaborate drapery and a crown placed by flying angels. The composition focuses on the numerous heavenly figures and the sanctity of the central figure's presence.

artworks.title: The Holy Family with the Three Hares
artworks.description: Three human figures are shown in the image. Two adult-sized figures stand side by side, with one holding a small infant. The woman on the left is seated, tilting slightly forward. She wears a veil covering her head and shoulders, and a long robe. The man next to her has a beard and holds a pouch. The infant has curly hair and is in a lively pose. Two angels fly above, holding a crown. Various plants, grasses, and rabbits are depicted around them. A landscape with a village, hills, and trees is shown in the background.

artworks.title: Bath House
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of figures in a medieval village setting, with architectural elements and musical instruments prominently featured. The scene features figures clad in minimal garments, engaged in a social or performance-like scenario. Detailed architecture reminiscent of medieval European towns, with towers and a bridge visible in the background. The foreground exhibits a mix of architectural and natural elements such as vines and a small plant. Various hats and tools are shown as points of visual interest, implying daily life activities. The drawing emphasizes shading and depth through texture and linework.

artworks.title: The Knight on Horseback and the Lansquenet
artworks.description: The image depicts a detailed scene viewed from a slightly elevated perspective. A knight on horseback, clad in ornate armor, is engaged with another richly dressed figure bearing a weapon. The artwork is executed in a precise line drawing style. The trees around the riders are drawn with textured bark. The landscape includes a castle with spires and turrets amid hills. The scene is monochromatic, emphasizing light and dark through the line work.

artworks.title: The Nativity
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 25.6 x 16.8 cm (10 1/16 x 6 5/8 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a woman seated gracefully, with a man standing beside her and an infant lying on the ground. The woman has long wavy hair, wearing a flowing robe, directing her gaze down towards the infant. The man stands slightly behind her with a gentle expression and a beard, holding a lantern in one hand and a staff in the other. The background features partially crumbling architecture with intricate arches, while the floor is stone with vegetation between the cracks. In the foreground, the infant lies on a cloth with a cow and a donkey nearby. Above, there are figures resembling angels within the roof's arches. The background displays a landscape with mountains and a small figure walking away.

artworks.title: The Agony in the Garden
artworks.description: The image depicts multiple figures with much of their bodies shown. In the foreground, one figure is kneeling in profile with hands clasped in prayer, facing left, with long hair and a beard, wearing a long robe. On the ground, three men are seated or reclining, all clothed in robes. Two of them are asleep, with their heads propped by hands or resting on shoulders, and one holds a sword. The third sitting figure is awake, holding a lantern and leaning against a large rock. In the background on a cliff, another figure with draped clothing is interacting with a winged being. In the right background, a group of armed soldiers approaches, wearing helmets and carrying spears. The scene is set in a rocky, mountainous terrain with some barren trees visible in the background.

artworks.title: The Betrayal and Capture of Christ
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 16.6 x 11.8 cm (6 9/16 x 4 5/8 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing featuring multiple figures engaged in a dynamic composition. The figures are holding various objects like a torch and a spear. The central figure is the focal point, surrounded by others in motion. The figures display a range of emotions. The background is minimal with a barren tree. The style resembles that of Albrecht Dürer, showcasing strong lines and detailed engravings typical of German Renaissance artworks.

artworks.title: Christ before Annas
artworks.description: The image shows multiple figures in a scene. In the center, a figure stands surrounded by others, with long hair, a robe, and bound wrists. The figure has a serene face with a mustache and a goatee, looking downwards. Around him are men in varied positions—one seated, others standing or leaning. The men have different expressions. One man holds a lantern and sticks. The figures wear historical or biblical-style clothing, including a turban and staff. A dog sits near the seated man. The background features arched structures suggesting an interior space, possibly a hall. The scene is intricately detailed in an engraving or historical drawing style.

artworks.title: The Flagellation
artworks.description: The image shows three figures. A central figure is tied to a post. The central figure is partially nude with cloth draped around the waist, and long wavy hair. Two men stand on either side, holding instruments. The men wear elaborate clothing with exaggerated folds. One wears a headpiece and appears to have a long beard, while the other has short hair. The background features large columns and arched passageways. Various objects are scattered on the ground, including ropes and tools, and a large piece of cloth. The image is monochrome, emphasizing detailed engravings and expressions.

artworks.title: Christ Crowned with Thorns
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 16.4 x 11.5 cm (6 7/16 x 4 1/2 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of figures surrounding a central figure with a crown of thorns. The composition features detailed expressions and garments, set in an architectural background. The figures are depicted in dynamic poses, creating an intense scene. Traditional shading techniques add depth and contrast, emphasizing the central figure. The artwork shows a style similar to late medieval or early Renaissance master engravers.

artworks.title: Christ before Pilate
artworks.description: The image shows a group of full-body figures engaged in different scenes. In the center, a man wearing a robe and a pointed hat sits with a dramatic expression. Another figure pours water over his hands. Other figures around them wear various attires, from armor to elegant robes. Many have distinct facial features like pointed beards or flowing hair. One man wears a crown of thorns and has a serene expression. There is a chair-like structure with ornate posts and cherubic figures carved on top. Two dogs are at the bottom, one shaggy and the other lithe. The background shows a mountainous or rocky landscape.

artworks.title: Ecce Homo
artworks.description: This is an image of a group of people in an architectural setting with a small dog at the foot of the scene. The composition features individuals surrounding a central figure in an archway. The central figure is draped in flowing garments. The surrounding figures exhibit emotional expressions and gestures. One person gestures towards the central figure in a possible moment of confrontation or proclamation. In the background, architectural elements with detailed stonework and archways are visible. A small dog is at the bottom of the scene, looking upwards. The hatching and line work create texture and depth, typical of traditional engraving techniques. The absence of color emphasizes the details in the figures' clothing and architecture.

artworks.title: The Bearing of the Cross with Saint Veronica
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 16.5 x 11.8 cm (6 1/2 x 4 5/8 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene involving a group of figures, one of whom carries a large wooden cross. The composition is densely packed with figures, each with intricate details. In the foreground, one figure holds a cloth displaying a face, while others interact with or observe the central figure carrying the cross. The background features an architectural element, suggesting a city gate or similar structure, from which spears and weapons protrude. The line work is precise, showcasing detailed expressions and clothing textures, typical of a woodcut or engraving style.

artworks.title: The Crucifixion
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a crucifixion scene with three figures below a cross and a figure on either side. The drawing depicts a central cross with a figure and the inscription "INRI" above it. Below and around the cross are additional figures, wrapped in robes and displaying expressions and postures of sorrow and contemplation. The setting appears to be a rocky landscape, and in the distance, a town is visible on the horizon with buildings and a bridge.

artworks.title: The Entombment
artworks.description: The scene depicts a figure being placed into a stone coffin by a group of people. The figure's arms hang loosely, face angled to one side, eyes closed, with a beard, long hair, and draped in cloth. The individuals surrounding him wear flowing garments. Some figures have expressive facial features, one appears to kiss the figure's hand. The clothing is detailed with folds and wrinkles. A crown of thorns is placed beside the body. In the background, there is a barren tree with twisting branches over a rocky formation.

artworks.title: Christ Appearing to Mary Magdalene
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 16.2 x 15.9 cm (6 3/8 x 6 1/4 in.)
artworks.description: This print depicts two figures: a woman on the left kneeling on a rocky outcrop in front of a standing man on the right. The woman wears long draped robes and a shawl covering her head. Her right hand is extended towards the man, while her left hand bunches the fabric of her shawl by her chest. In front of her is a small, upright container, like a jar with a lid. The man has long hair and a beard, and he stands with his body toward us and his head turned left, towards the woman, reaching one hand out to her. In his other hand, he holds a thin staff with a cross on top which appears to have a banner hanging from it, although the banner is mostly concealed by the man's body. He is draped in cloth, with part of his torso exposed to reveal a deep gash in his side. There are circular wounds on the tops of his bare feet. The background shows a rural setting with a wooden fence and a bare tree in the center, behind which are hills with more trees under a blank sky. The background of the print is off-white paper.

artworks.title: Death of the Virgin
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 25.7 × 17 cm (10 1/8 × 6 11/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a medieval scene in an interior setting. The drawing depicts a detailed and intricate scene inside a room with a canopy bed. An elegantly dressed figure lies on the bed, surrounded by several robed figures, some carrying staffs, one holding a candle, and another reading from a book. The figures appear to be engaged in an important or solemn activity. The scene is rich in texture with attention to drapery, facial expressions, and various objects suggesting an atmosphere of significance or reverence.

artworks.title: Saint John the Evangelist
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing on short grass. The person has curly hair and defined facial features with a calm expression. They are wearing long, flowing robes with intricate detailing. Their right hand is raised with delicately positioned fingers, while their left hand holds a cup with a snake-like embellishment. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Saint Michael Slaying the Dragon
artworks.description: This is a drawing depicting an angelic figure standing triumphantly over a defeated beast. The central figure is a winged angel wearing long robes and a detailed cloak. The angel is holding a staff or spear, pressed down onto the beast below. The beast has chaotic dragon-like features with claws, a serpentine tail, and a contorted face. The artist used intricate line work to depict texture and detail in the clothing, feathers, and hair. The scene conveys a dramatic struggle and victory, rendered in precise black-and-white lines reminiscent of engravings from the Northern Renaissance.

artworks.title: Christ Blessing the Virgin
artworks.description: The image shows two full-body figures seated beside each other. The figure on the left is a woman with long, wavy hair and a crown. She is wearing a gown that extends to the floor and has her hands clasped in front of her. The figure on the right is a man with a crown, halo, long hair, and a beard, wearing a robe. He holds a globus cruciger in one hand and gestures with the other. Both figures are seated on a structure with a curved backrest, and behind them are three angels with wings. The background is a simple architectural setting.

artworks.title: God Appearing to Noah
artworks.description: The image depicts a scene with multiple figures. A bearded man is shown floating or being carried by cherubic figures. He has a full head of hair and a long beard, and his expression is intent as he points with one hand and stretches the other towards a door. He is dressed in a long robe. Beside him, three cherubic figures assist him in the air. Below, another man kneels with a child clinging to him; this man also has a beard and is clothed in a similar long robe. To the right, a woman stands holding a child; she is wearing a long dress with her hair tied back, and behind her, another child peeks from inside the doorway. The setting includes a sturdy wooden door and a ground covered with grass and a few small plants.

artworks.title: The Lamentation of the Virgin
artworks.description: The image shows two figures - one lying down and the other standing. The lying figure is male, laying horizontally on a stone slab with a slight inclination in the head. The figure is partially covered with cloth around the waist, revealing a muscular torso and has long curly hair and a beard. The standing figure, positioned to the left of the lying figure, appears female and is covered in a flowing dress and cloak. This figure has a halo around the head and delicate features with eyes looking downward. The background shows a rocky outcrop, trees, distant hills, small buildings, and figures engaging in various activities. The sky is depicted with clouds.
